purpose: Separate direct historical li+ameke parses, paradigm-supported candidates, and graphic false positives after direct audit of the official Merrill 2020 PDF.

H_D2_strong_paradigmatic_support_not_dir.merrill_cross_reference: cf. tschutschelíameke after the explicit tsanelíameke derivation
H_D2_strong_paradigmatic_support_not_dir.assessment: Strongly compatible with internal -li followed by -ameke, but the audited PDF does not provide a second explicit morpheme-by-morpheme derivation.

H_FP_graphic_false_positive_controls.actual_analysis: lexical verb uilí 'esperar, quedarse de pie, quedarse quieto' + PTCP -ameke
H_FP_graphic_false_positive_controls.lesson: Surface ...líameke is insufficient evidence for suffixal -li.

independent_historical_morphotactic_cont: Merrill suffix table explicitly lists passive -li + nominalizer/instrumental -la
epistemic_rule: A historical string ending in -líameke counts as li+ameke only if the lexical base or an explicit source parse independently establishes suffixal -li. Graphic substring matching alone is invalidated by uilíameke.
next_tests: Search for an explicit parse of tschutschelíameke in other published analyses of Steffel or the unpublished grammar if accessible.
Search the historical corpus for additional families where the same root independently has a -li form plus an -ameke form.
Use the false-positive rule when mechanically mining all historical -ameke strings.
